CHIEF COMPLAINT
Status post mitral valve repair follow-up.

HISTORY OF PRESENT ILLNESS
Patient is a 63-year-old female presenting for follow-up evaluation. She underwent mitral valve repair on 8/3/2020. She reports feeling much better since surgery compared to her preoperative state. She continues to experience occasional chest discomfort with associated shallow breathing, occurring a few times per month. Episodes last only a few minutes and resolve spontaneously. She has learned to manage symptoms by slowing down during exertion, after which she can usually resume activities. She denies new symptoms otherwise. She reports good medication adherence using a reminder app.
